messages:
anna: Quick design pass on the new console dark theme. A few nits in the dashboard: chart gradients feel muddy, inline code background is low contrast, and token breakdown chips lose hierarchy. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/mock-screenshot :eyes:
marc: Agree on gradients — the blue→violet transition makes axis labels harder to read. Maybe reduce saturation or add a subtle border on chart areas.
kevin: +1. Also inline code uses a near-black overlay (looks like #0b0f14 with 0.35) so `curl` examples blend into the panel.
jess: Can we try swapping code bg to `#0f172a` and bumping code text to `#e6eef8`? That moves us closer to ~7:1 contrast.
anna: Accessibility note: some small sparkline series are failing AA (contrast ~3.2:1). Primary series should be >= 4.5:1 for label readability.
marc: Quick token proposal (CSS vars):
```
--bg-panel: #0b1020;
--code-bg: #0f172a;
--muted-text: #9fb0c8;
--accent-1: #6dd3ff;
--accent-2: #9b7bff;
```
Ran a quick check — axis labels @14px pass 4.5:1 with these.
kevin: One UX copy nit: the theme toggle currently shows 'Dark'/'Light' and a tooltip says 'Low-power mode' — that's confusing. Suggest keep toggle labels simple and add an explicit setting for "Low power (reduced animations)".
jess: Also copy tweak: change "Token usage by route" → "Token usage — route breakdown" for clarity in the tokens panel.
anna: design-bot pushed a story to a feature branch with these token vars: `theme/refactor-contrast`. :sparkles:
design-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/421 — includes color variables and chart legend reorder. CI: 2 snapshot diffs (chart gradients).
marc: For gradients, try shifting midpoint lighter (move 50% → 35%). That preserves peak color while improving midrange contrast.
kevin: I can run a quick A/B deploy in staging if we lock variables. If everyone's ok I can push today.
jess: Request: add a "High contrast charts" toggle in Accessibility settings (default off). Very helpful for demos & a11y testing.
anna: Action items: kevin to deploy A/B; marc to adjust gradient midpoints; jess to update copy strings; anna to run a full contrast audit and post results by EOD. :calendar:
kevin: On it. :thumbsup:
